qa_pairs.question: What are the default storage quotas and backup policies for Home, Scratch, Project, and Nearline spaces on the Narval and Rorqual clusters?
qa_pairs.answer: On the Narval and Rorqual clusters, Home space has a default quota of 50 GB and 500,000 files per user and is backed up. Scratch space offers 20 TB and 1 million files per user, but is not backed up and files older than 60 days are purged. Project space provides 1 TB and 500,000 files per group and is backed up. Nearline space has a default of 1 TB and 5,000 files per group and is also backed up.

qa_pairs.question: How can users increase their project or nearline storage quotas on the Narval and Rorqual clusters?
qa_pairs.answer: On the Narval and Rorqual clusters, project space can be increased up to 40 TB per group and nearline space up to 100 TB per group via a Rapid Access Service (RAS) request. The group's sponsoring PI should contact technical support for such requests. For quota changes larger than those permitted by RAS, an application to the annual Resource Allocation Competition is necessary.
